content_sections.heading: About DDSCBL
content_sections.text: The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is a state co-operative bank licensed by the RBI (Licence No. Dos. RO (AH). REG/LIC.S-2187/04.36.000/2023-24 dated 07 March 2024). Its Head Office is in Dilip Nagar, Nani Daman, and its Administration Department issued this notice. You can reach that department on 0260 2255984 and 2255985, or by email at [email protected] . The internship is part of NABARD's scheme for engaging Cooperative Interns to strengthen cooperatives. The National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) runs the scheme, NABARD monitors it and state co-operative banks carry it out.

content_sections.heading: DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The bank pays TA/DA from its own funds. The Rs.25,000 remuneration is reimbursed from the Cooperative Education Fund of the Ministry of Cooperation through NCDC. content_sections.heading: DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be at least 21 years old and no older than 30. MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management / Cooperative Management / Agri Business Management / Rural Development Management. Essential: proficiency in computer. The bank asks candidates to read the full eligibility criteria and essential requirements in NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024, which comes with the official notification, before applying.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Cooperative Intern
content_sections.text: Work with PACS and other primary cooperatives and guide them in carrying out the initiatives of the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India. Solve day-to-day problems PACS face with computerisation, business plans, projects, financing and various approvals. Prepare and share a weekly status report on these initiatives, in coordination with the DCCB/StCB. The scheme aims to take the cooperative movement down to the grassroots. It also lets professional graduates learn how cooperatives work in practice and builds a pool of experienced cooperative professionals.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is purely an internship programme for one year only. NCDC funds it, and the bank carries no liability. It is not an appointment or employment and does not promise one. No intern has any right or claim to a job with the bank because of this internship. The internship is full-time. The intern must keep the bank's working hours. The bank may post or transfer interns according to its functional needs. Interns get 10 days of Casual Leave for the year and no other leave. Any other leave is treated as "Leave without remuneration". The bank's holidays may apply to interns. The internship may end at any time, with no financial benefit, if performance is not satisfactory or the intern is absent without the bank's permission. The bank may also end it at any time without giving a reason. Interns must keep all documents, reports and information confidential. Breaking this rule has legal consequences. Interns may not deal with or represent the bank to print, electronic or social media. They may not post their work on social media without express permission from the competent authority. Interns must follow the rules and regulations of the bank and behave professionally with the bank and the public.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the official notification and NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024 on the bank's website . Write your application on plain paper with your complete bio-data. Attach the documents listed below. Address it to: The General Manager (ADM), The Daman & Diu State Cooperative Bank Ltd., Head Office- H. No. 14/54, 1st Floor, Dilipnagar, Nani Daman- 396210. Make sure it reaches the Head Office by 05:00 PM on 23 November 2026. Applications that arrive after that will be rejected outright. Self-attested copies of certificates showing your age, eligibility, educational qualification and experience A recent coloured passport-size photograph Any updates on this recruitment will be posted on the bank's website.

faq.question: Q1. How many Cooperative Interns is the bank hiring?
faq.answer: One. The intern will work in Diu District for one year.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification do I need?
faq.answer: An MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management, Cooperative Management, Agri Business Management or Rural Development Management. Proficiency in computer is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: You must be between 21 and 30 years old.

faq.question: Q4. How much does the internship pay?
faq.answer: A consolidated Rs.25,000 a month. TA/DA is paid separately by the bank from its own funds.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply online?
faq.answer: No. Send your bio-data on plain paper with self-attested certificate copies and a coloured passport-size photograph to the General Manager (ADM) at the Head Office in Nani Daman - 396210.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Your application must reach the Head Office by 05:00 PM on 23 November 2026. Late applications will be rejected outright.

faq.question: Q7. Will the internship lead to a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the engagement is neither an appointment nor an assurance of employment, and interns have no claim to a job with the bank.

faq.question: Q8. How much leave does a Cooperative Intern get?
faq.answer: 10 days of Casual Leave for the year. Any other leave is treated as leave without remuneration.

faq.question: Q9. What work will the intern do?
faq.answer: The intern guides PACS and other primary cooperatives on Ministry of Cooperation initiatives. The work includes computerisation, business plans, projects, financing and approvals, along with a weekly status report.
